title: Eclipse Over Ancient Theater
description: A surreal scene set in a vast ancient amphitheater filled with a silent crowd of silhouetted figures. In the foreground, a translucent woman with closed eyes and ornate hair stands with one hand raised, her form overlaid with glowing particles and architectural ruins, while a massive red eclipse and a glowing green planet dominate the fiery orange sky.
